aboutMore: more about me bc usagi-chan says my about me is 'all tracing.' (its not) (it was for a while). i moved to sacramento the summer before 8th grade from fresno and didnt know anybody till anime club. i draw on the back of my homework, on my arm, on the bus window when its foggy. my aunt jo has the scanner i use (HP, 600 dpi) n every scan comes out w/ one small gray cat hair in the corner. i leave it in. its her signature. i draw hands wrong on purpose sometimes (6 fingers is canon) n i draw hooves RIGHT bc meg taught me. i still need a real wacom.

blog.title: where Mika Destruction came from (the real story) (a short one)
blog.body: ok. so in august before 8th grade my family moved from fresno to sacramento. i didnt know a single person. on the first day of school i sat at the end of a long lunch table w/ a spiral notebook and a green pencil, bc the green was the only one that was sharp. i wanted a guitar. my parents said 'after the car is fixed.' the car was never fixed. so i drew a scythe that turns into a guitar. i drew her half demon bc shes two things at once n neither one feels like home yet. green hair bc the pencil. thats it. thats the whole origin. that day she got a name n i got a nickname n they were the same. i know shes a character. i know im a person. but when i draw her im brave. it took me 4 hours to draw her hands that first day n they were WRONG n i kept them. my report card still says michelle. ms takeda crossed it out in pen on the roster n wrote 'mika.' i didnt ask her to. she just did. i keep that roster page in my sketchbook.

blog.title: how to draw hands (a tutorial by someone who is bad at them)
blog.body: ok everyone asks. here is the method. STEP 1: do NOT start w/ fingers. start w/ a mitten. a flat sad mitten. STEP 2: the thumb is a separate project. give it its own page of respect. STEP 3: knuckles are 4 small hills, not a row of soldiers. they go UP and DOWN. STEP 4: count. five fingers. sometimes six, for love. STEP 5: draw your own hand. in pen. on the bus. the first 3 will make u cry. thats normal. STEP 6: ur own hand is the only reference that is always with u, even at 2am, even in class, even when ur mad. thats the whole secret. hands take me 4 of 6 hours every time bc i hate them n i keep trying. i think thats what being an artist is. its someone who keeps trying to draw the one thing they cant. also hooves. meg taught me hooves. hooves are harder than hands. there is a thing called a fetlock. i didnt know. its like learning a secret language.

blog.title: my first artist alley table (a report) (3 sales, 1 kid)
blog.body: i got a half table at the con downtown for $25, shared w/ a girl named noor who draws cats in ties. price list taped to the front: chibi sketch card $3. headshot $5. full OC $12. hands +$2. hooves +$5 (meg's rule). 'no tracing' in the corner, small, like a threat in a nice font. i sold 3 prints ($3 each) n 6 sketch cards n a noor cat to a man who was not buying for a child. slow hours. usagi-chan came w/ pocky n sat in the empty chair like a guard. sephiroth read my price list w/ notes. then at about 3pm, an 11 yr old in a Fullmetal cosplay stood at my table for 10 min n then said, very quietly, 'is that Mika Destruction? from dA?' she had a folder. in the folder: part 1 of the backstory, PRINTED, w/ HIGHLIGHTS. she asked me to sign it. i drew a tiny scythe n said 'its a guitar too.' she said 'i KNEW it.' i went to the bathroom and cried a normal amount. that was the con. thats all i needed. i sold 3 prints. i got 1 reader.

blog.title: my tools (ranked by how much i would cry if they died)
blog.body: 1. Pigma Micron 05, black. i own 4. one dried out in july. we had a funeral. it was silent. 2. the 6 copics. $7 each. violet dried out (RIP) but i put it in water last night n it gave me 4 more lines. 4 LINES. 3. the Wacom Graphire. it has given me a callus on my middle finger and a driver that crashes whenever i zoom past 400%. i love it. i need a real one, an Intuos, $99. my fund is at $31.50. 4. the kneaded eraser shaped like a sleeping cat. its named mochi. mochi has seen things. 5. the X-Acto for screentone. i cut screentone by hand at 1am. i have lost feeling in 2 fingertips and gained 1 backstory page. worth it. 6. my aunt jos scanner. not mine, but the most important thing on this list. she lets me come on saturdays n her cat toast sits on the glass n thats why every scan has a gray hair in the corner. i never edit it out. its a signature. its a co-author.

survey.title: the 'artist ask-me-anything' survey from dA (answered at 1am w/ a micron in my teeth)
qa: name (the one u use):
mika. mika destruction is my OC. we have the same name. she came first. i changed mine
how long have u been drawing:
since i could hold a crayon. seriously. seriously seriously. my first OC was a crayon. its on the fridge. it has a cape
favorite color:
green. her hair. the pencil. u can see where this goes
tablet:
a graphire. its older than my annoyance. i need a real wacom. i'm at $31.50 of $99
hands rating (1-10):
4. up from a 2. i am proud. i am so proud. there is a callus
what are you drawing right now:
the rest of luna's wolf pack (ashfang, duskhowl, willow. THREE wolves. ZERO hands. i am the happiest i have ever been) n part 7 of the backstory
most embarrassing early drawing:
a horse w/ 4 legs on one side. i was 9. i called it 'pegasus (grounded).' meg has it framed. i dont know how
do u trace:
no. i used a lightbox ONCE to ink my own pencils. thats allowed. thats a tool. i know the difference. i can tell the difference. i'm good at it
a character u didnt create that u love:
edward elric. his arm. his mother. the way he makes a face when someone says short. i have drawn him 90 times. 4 were good
how many sketchbooks:
11. one has a rubber band as a lock. one has a roster page in the back that says 'mika' in a teacher's pen
dream project:
a full-length comic. 120 pages. Mika Destruction vs. her own clan. w/ a good ending. i have the ending. i just dont know the middle
what do u do when a drawing goes wrong:
i turn the page. then i turn it back. then i draw a cat on it. the cat is always fine

aunt jo asked what my OC eats for breakfast. i said 'a bowl of cereal w/ a scythe in it.' she said 'no, what does SHE eat.' i said toast. she wrote it down. shes making a notebook of facts about Mika Destruction. shes the first fan. shes 51 n works at a dentist. i dont know what to do w/ my face
i drew a hand in 40 min today. a RECORD. it has 5 fingers. it looks like a hand. i cried. usagi-chan said 'is it a trace' i said 'its a MIRACLE'

a kid in my art class asked me to teach them 'how to be good at hands.' i said 'u draw ur own hand 1000 times.' they came back w/ ONE hand. it was good. i sat down on the floor. they said 'is it good?' i said 'it has 5 fingers n a knuckle.' they said 'yes!' i said 'then its a hand'
